deathDayLines.line: — DAY 27 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
🥣 Dmitri of Emberhold stands at your fire, thinner than pride allows. "Emberhold is eating bark. We're asking — 1,411 kcal, whatever you can spare. We'll remember it."
(They beg — give from the beats row, or refuse aloud. If they once fed you, refusing costs double.)
Zafer Gul reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cool.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ HIGHBEAM DEER! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
It BELLOWS — wrong, too deep, like a foghorn heard through water. The sound sits in your teeth.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming.
📓 Codex: Counter: MOVE, don't stare — When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming.
The deer's head swings toward you. Another light in its eyes. You're all on the list now.
The Highbeam Deer thrashes its antlers at you — getting close has a price.
Highbeam Deer's antlers hits you for 10.
The light behind its eyes swells to a painful glare. The whine climbs past hearing. It is done aiming — now it is only waiting to loose.
💥 Ocular Discharge! A ray of light lances FROM ITS EYES — and it's swinging toward you. MOVE.
The light touches the ground where you were standing. It has not found you yet.
The beam swings wide, scorching the earth where you were.
The beam swings wide, scorching the earth where you were.
The beam carves a bright arc across the ground, swinging after its target. It does not blink. It does not hurry.

Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Leonard is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

🕯️ Leonard Dixon is dead — combat. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
"Leonard's gone." Guadalupe looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Leonard." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Finn blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
📖 LEARNED: Shoulder Check (Level 1). You know exactly where to hit something with your shoulder so it goes where YOU want. Shove a controlled monster 2 tiles — into its friends, away from yours.

📖 LEARNED: Hogtie (Level 1). Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Leonard Dixon, 27 days. The mantle passes to Finn Menon.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Finn Menon, 24 — a Rancher.
The village's quarrel was with Leonard — and Leonard is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Guadalupe speaks for Finn — "Leonard trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Finn before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. For one evening, grief sits at the fire with them instead of standing over them. (−3,242 kcal from the pantry)

🔥 The fire settles. Sam has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Murkcap — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Zafer breathes "We've been walking past those." Guadalupe mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.

💛 You hold Mixtape. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)
⬆️ Beast-calm deepened to L2! Your calm is contagious.
"Oh! OH! You're starting to GET it! The audience loves the little ah-ha moments! The odds just shifted!"

🩸 The Highbeam Deer mauled Zafer (-46 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.
🩸 The Highbeam Deer mauled Ingrid (-44 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

You give Emberhold 1,500 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Dmitri weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
🎁 Haven's first gesture: 2,000 kcal walks to Stonebridge's fire — a gift, no strings. They count it, and they remember who sent it. (Trust +10.)
🌾 Haven sends 1,500 kcal of grain to Stonebridge's fire — not tribute, the other way around. Someone's grandmother over there will remember who fed her. (Trust +8.)
⛓️ Finn brings it home: Thornfield bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Finn speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Three weeks. That's how long before a handshake is a relationship — the System will say so when it's true. Tend this fire.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.

📺 SYSTEM: "We have filed a request for the sky to be less bruised. It is pending. The sky has not responded."
